items.title: M2 — OAuth2 PKCE auth + live REST client
items.detail: Wire AuthManager (PKCE against the institution IdP) and exercise OnBaseRestClient against a real OnBase host: document types, keyword types, lifecycles, and document binaries. This is the single biggest gap between pre-POC and POC — today everything runs on fixtures.

items.title: M3 — Unity API client
items.detail: Reach Unity-only capabilities (dashboards, full lifecycle definitions) the REST API doesn't expose, via a small C# HTTP shim or REST overlap. UnityClient currently raises NotImplementedError on every method.

items.title: M4–M9 — live schema + metadata collector
items.detail: Replace fixture schema.json with a live-pulled OnBase schema; download doc types, keyword types, lifecycles, dashboards, and work folders into the local store; build the navigable schema browser HTML (MapSnap-style).

items.title: Auto-fallback hardening
items.detail: OnBaseSource.mode=auto already falls back to fixtures on any live failure. Add explicit connection-health surfacing in the UI so an operator can tell whether answers came from live OnBase or fixtures.

items.title: Implement /version and /info
items.detail: Only GET /health exists. Add GET /version (project=cognibase, semver, status) and GET /info (this project's qi_registry.json entry) to honour the QI module interface contract every project must implement.

items.title: Stand up QI_CogniBase + QI_CogniBaseTunnel
items.detail: Both services are documented in QI_Service_Registry.md (venv python, AppDirectory C:\APPS\CogniBase, requires sqlglot) and a named tunnel cognibase.quiddityinnovations.com is reserved — but neither is installed/running 24/7. Register with NSSM and confirm the public tunnel.

items.title: Run qi_validator.py --project cognibase
items.detail: Validate folder layout, naming, and contract compliance against QI_Standards.md before promoting beyond pre-POC. Reconcile the project's capital-A 'Application' package layout with QI standards.

items.title: Promote status from pre_poc
items.detail: Once a live OnBase connection works end-to-end and a real (non-fixture) anchor materializes, update qi_registry.json status from pre_poc to poc/active_development with an honest milestone note.

items.title: M10 — OnBase Web Client look-alike retrieval UI
items.detail: Replace DESIGN/mockup.html (served at GET /) with the real retrieval UI: keyword search, doc-type filters, result grid, document viewer — decoupled from any installed OnBase client.

items.title: M11–M13 — templated + dashboard reports
items.detail: Finish reports/template_engine.py and dashboard_repro.py: generate .docx reports from templates and reproduce OnBase Unity dashboards. Blocked on the Unity client (M3).

items.title: M14 — Settings UI
items.detail: Vendor management, API-key entry (env-indirected), source configuration, and active-flag toggles in the browser instead of hand-editing settings.json.

items.title: Real RBAC
items.detail: Replace header-based actor identity (X-Admin-User / X-CB-Group) on capability endpoints with real authentication and role enforcement before any multi-user deployment.

items.title: M20-wire — entity resolver into the materializer
items.detail: EntityResolver is built and tested but not yet invoked during materialization. Wire it so anchored records are clustered by entity (deterministic keys + fuzzy name match) as they land in the lake.

items.title: M21 — anchor-scoped agent with bridge-aware UNION rewriting
items.detail: An agent loop that, given a workspace, rewrites queries to UNION across bridged silo members at query time — the practical payoff of the Bridges feature.

items.title: M22–M23 — cross-source reports + grounding
items.detail: Reports that span multiple anchored sources, with explicit grounding/provenance so every figure traces back to a source record.

items.title: LLM-assisted capability drafter
items.detail: Upgrade the heuristic drafter stub to call the active chat vendor: turn an admin's plain-English intent into a validated SQL capability draft, with the validator gating the result before save.

items.title: M24 — Canvas v1
items.detail: Bar / Pie / KPI / Grid chart primitives plus Rect / Ellipse / Arrow / Text annotations for building report canvases.

items.title: M25 — AI-driven lifecycle canvas (killer demo)
items.detail: Extend the M25-minimal SVG lifecycle visualizer into an AI-driven canvas that 'breathes' with live state-population counts — the headline demo for BU.

items.title: Semantic chunker
items.detail: Replace the character-window chunker with a semantic splitter so embeddings respect record/section boundaries and improve retrieval precision.
